t: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
d: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

t: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
st: The Last Night of a Jockey
d: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

t: The Twilight Zone: Living Doll
d: Erich is displeased when his wife buys an expensive doll for his step-daughter. He becomes even more displeased when the doll tells him it doesn't like him!

t: The Twilight Zone: Meet in the Middle
d: Lonely bachelor Phil (Jimmi Simpson) finds meaningful human connection when he discovers a telepathic link to a stranger named Annie (Gillian Jacobs). Their connection quickly sparks a romance.

t: The Twilight Zone: Downtime
d: After a recent promotion to hotel manager, Michelle (Morena Baccarin) feels like she's on top of the world, but any cause for celebration is short lived when the nature of her reality is called into question. Colman Domingo and Tony Hale also guest star.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Old Man in the Cave
st: The Old Man in the Cave
d: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.

t: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
d: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

t: The Twilight Zone: Probe 7, Over and Out
d: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

t: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
st: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
d: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Who of You
d: Struggling actor Harry (Ethan Embry) risks everything to catch his big break, but an impulsive scheme takes a few turns no one saw coming. Daniel Sunjata and Billy Porter also guest star.

t: The Twilight Zone: Ovation
d: The music career of struggling singer Jasmine takes off overnight after she witnesses a tragic incident. Jasmine begins receiving rapturous applause everywhere she goes, but she soon realizes the relentless recognition comes at a steep cost.

t: The Twilight Zone: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
st: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
d: Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.

t: The Twilight Zone: Ninety Years Without Slumbering
d: An old man fears that he will die if his grandfather clock stops running.

t: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
d: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

t: The Twilight Zone: You Drive
d: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.

t: The Twilight Zone: Among The Untrodden
d: Transfer student Irene's (Sophia Macy) unusual interests make her an easy target at her new all-girls boarding school until she discovers that popular classmate Madison (Abbie Hern) possesses a unique talent.

t: The Twilight Zone: 8.0
d: At the outer reaches of the world, a team of scientists discover a new highly intelligent species, but its existence may endanger more than their research. Joel McHale, Nadia Hilker, Michelle Ang, Tim Armstrong, and Brandon Jay McLaren guest star.

t: The Twilight Zone: The Long Morrow
d: Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...

t: The Twilight Zone: The Self-Improvement of Salvadore Ross
d: A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

t: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
st: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
d: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.

t: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
d: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

t: The Twilight Zone: A Human Face
d: A grieving couple's (Chris Meloni and Jenna Elfman) move is interrupted by an otherworldly encounter, leading them to second guess what's worth leaving behind. Tavi Gevinson also guest stars.

t: The Twilight Zone: A Small Town
d: A quiet church handyman (Damon Wayans Jr.) uncovers a magical scale model imbuing him with the power to help his struggling small town. But with the sleazy Mayor Conway (David Krumholtz) taking all the credit, will Jason's good intentions be corrupted?

t: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
d: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

t: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
d: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

t: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
d: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

t: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
st: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
d: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

t: The Twilight Zone: Try, Try
d: When the quick-witted Claudia (Kylie Bunbury) has a chance run-in with Mark (Topher Grace) at a museum, he dazzles her with his seemingly miraculous abilities. But after the true source of his charisma is revealed, the encounter takes a dark turn.
